validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from 300-dpi crops of the table half of each spread (one page per image, about 18 images) plus zooms on doubtful cells; tesseract used only as a cross-check (it misreads '1' quantities). Numerical index (pp40-43) compared line by line against an aligned rendering of the expected index, both directions.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except printed gaps: chassis_hood refs 54-63 (table jumps 53 to 64), motion_drive refs 45-59 (44 to 60), transaxle refs 16, 19, 24, 63, flywheel_stator refs 2 and 6, carburetor refs 26, 27 and 43. Repeated refs kept as printed: engine_block 9, 18, 19 and 21 (size/thickness options), carburetor ref 0 (three different parts). Ref 0 also on engine_block (gasket set). Electrical refs 35A/35B. Ref 53A in the transaxle. One row has no part number and no qty (decals ref 3, 'REFERENCE ONLY').
validation.quantities: All rows carry a qty except 6 rows with none printed: motion_drive 89, 90, 91; transaxle 72, 77; decals 3. Inch quantities kept as printed (chassis trim strip 77.5", gas line 6"). No UAR rows. Qty column is in register on every page. Carburetor refs 5 and 6 print qty 5 and 6 (zoom-checked; probably misprints, kept).
validation.numericalIndex: All 677 (part, page, ref) entries expected from the transcription were compared with the printed index (10 columns, pp40-43), both directions; everything matches except three differences: the index prints C33370 for engine-block ref 35 (table C33377); it prints C35472 for decal ref 7 (table C36472); and it lists ref 0 rows (C27255, C30422, C30424, C31978) with no ref number. C35798 (pre-painted deck ref 21) is printed the same in table and index. Hardware codes 11-312 and 41-24 appear in the index as 011- 312 / 041- 24. The 11 NSS rows and the decal ref 3 row have no part number and are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs 'BR' numbers stored bare (391406), Case letter prefixes stored as printed closed up (C35064, C34536), hardware codes 'NNN-NNNN' as printed (187-1508). This book prints no spaces after the prefix or hyphen, so partNoAsPrinted equals the stored form except for BR prefixes. '*' and '**' part-number cells stored as NSS with the footnote; footnote marks on C34517*, C34536*, C35036** and C35351** are removed from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted.
